Fault torn-state x repeated ref/unref, listener add/remove, calls after exit: at most one hold per object, each releases only its own; after 'exit' both are null and ref/unref do nothing
Fault torn-state x removeAllListeners('message') / removeAllListeners() on a Worker; close() on a listened parentPort: the public port is released as in Node; a closed parentPort never holds again
Fault torn-state x a Worker constructor that throws (invalid path, eval with a URL): no hold taken; a valid Worker holds from construction

Fault observable-order x worker messages (including one posted from the worker's own 'exit' listener) vs the parent's 'exit': every message arrives first; the hold is released only at the Worker's end

Fault peer death x a kernel peer closing, or the DOM Worker boundary refusing the spawn; a peer death or failed start (refused spawn, data: URL gap, same-realm load failure) whose 'error' has no listener: 'error' then 'exit' 1, every hold released, the parent never hangs; an unlistened 'error' is the parent's uncaught exception (never held back by the kernel's teardown), 'exit' 1 follows unless it ended the parent; rifty takes an unloaded Node run's order (after the handling's microtasks when listened, between the uncaught exception and its microtasks otherwise); browser carrier compares Node's timing-independent rows
